rule: Reasoning depth, execution depth and device hydration are orthogonal configuration dimensions.
hydration_definition: Hydration is the bounded acquisition or resolution of the minimum missing source, structure, semantics, relations, view context, state, capability, execution context or external witness needed for a declared task. Hydration never by itself promotes authority, evidence, release status or physical truth.

hydration_terms.hydrate: Resolve a declared missing dependency into the current authorised working projection with source/root/readback binding.
hydration_terms.dehydrated: Required information or capability is intentionally absent from the current projection; absence is not zero, false or deletion.
hydration_terms.rehydrate: Repeat hydration against a newer verified revision/root or after cache loss while preserving prior DBR lineage.
hydration_terms.lazy_hydration: Defer hydration until a requested view/action proves the dependency is actually needed.
hydration_terms.selective_hydration: Hydrate only explicitly required planes/fragments rather than the whole object or corpus.
hydration_terms.progressive_hydration: PQH: begin from the smallest sufficient packet and add one discriminating plane at a time only when insufficiency remains.
hydration_terms.source_hydration: Acquire or verify exact native bytes/provider reference under source identity, revision/hash, ACL/licence and owner constraints.
hydration_terms.cache_hydration: Resolve a content-addressed reference from already verified local bytes; a cache hit is not provider or authority proof.
hydration_terms.structural_hydration: Resolve container/manifest/topology/geometry structure without inventing semantics.
hydration_terms.semantic_hydration: Apply only registered typed adapters/dictionaries/units/relations to source-bound structure; unsupported meaning remains UNKNOWN.
hydration_terms.dependency_hydration: Resolve parent/child, relation, invalidation and cross-domain dependency closure by stable references.
hydration_terms.lens_hydration: Select a deterministic policy-constrained projection over already admitted semantics; a lens does not create facts.
hydration_terms.state_hydration: Resolve prior/current state roots, sparse deltas, DBR/history and conflict branches without timestamp-wins overwrite.
hydration_terms.capability_hydration: Resolve available installed tools/adapters/models/device capabilities and scoped leases; capability availability is not execution authority.
hydration_terms.execution_hydration: Bind exact inputs, capability, lease, rollback and receipt requirements for a bounded action; planning is not execution.
hydration_terms.witness_hydration: Attach attributable measured/calibrated/professional/external evidence to the graph. It cannot be synthesized from digital inference.
hydration_terms.scatter: Fan out source-bound references or permitted bytes across layers/nodes/lenses while retaining one owning Object_ID/root lineage and explicit scope.
hydration_terms.gather: Recompose scattered fragments only when manifest/context/prior roots and permissions reconcile exactly; conflicts remain explicit.
hydration_terms.reconstruct: Rebuild a declared representation from admitted fragments. Reconstruction quality/state must remain labelled and is not source identity unless bitwise proof exists.
hydration_terms.infer: Derive a new model/AI result from admitted inputs. Inference is never hydration of missing source truth.
hydration_terms.resolve: Choose or compute the bounded interpretation/action allowed by existing contracts after hydration; unresolved ambiguity remains HOLD/UNKNOWN.
hydration_terms.project: Render a view/representation from admitted state under a lens and evidence/security ceiling; projection is non-authoritative by generation alone.

hydration_planes.purpose: Stable object/source/owner/revision/hash/ACL/licence/root identity needed before any other hydration.
Exact native bytes or content-addressed verified references.
Manifest, container, topology, geometry, section/chunk and parent structure.
Registered types, units, dictionaries, equations and source-bound semantic fields.
Typed edges, dependency closure, inheritance, bridges and invalidation dependencies.
Task/device/audience/role projection chosen after security and evidence constraints.
Prior/current state, DBR history, sparse deltas, contradictions and replay context.
Installed/local/peer adapter, model, compute, renderer and transport capability plus scoped lease.
Bounded action packet with verified inputs, target, lease, rollback and readback/receipt contract.
Measured/calibrated/professional/external evidence returned by authorised real-world or provider process.

hydration_orthogonality: H0-H9 are dependency planes, not runtime Z-floor numbers and not semantic Z-depth labels.
Device hydration profile controls delivery/fidelity and may reduce a requested plane; it cannot widen authority.
Reasoning depth, execution depth, device hydration, semantic XY/Z/T, Morton byte indexing, domain ownership and evidence maturity remain distinct axes.
A task may hydrate multiple planes but should stop at the minimum sufficient closure for that task.
